title: The Scales Tip Toward the Mountain
skyStory: Still full and glowing at ninety-eight percent, the moon lingers in Libra, scales in hand, measuring fairness across the sky. It notices something: the Fire Tiger just got a whole birthday of love, and the Mountain has been giving all winter. Venus raises an eyebrow. Libra adjusts a weight. The scales tip, gently, toward Nancy, and the shore glows a little brighter tonight.

reading: You had your day. Now the scales swing the other way, and the Tiger's best move is to turn all that birthday warmth outward. Today your gift is attention: specific, generous, undivided attention aimed at someone who usually gives it to others.

Send Nancy a message today listing three things she did this winter that made a real difference to you. Be precise. Name the day, the words she used, the moment. The scales want balance, and balance means she gets to hear how much she gives. Then switch the onyx to your right wrist for an hour and send strength across the water. She will feel it.
joel.mission: Switch the onyx to your right wrist for one hour this afternoon and send strength to Nancy across the water.
joel.omen: Two of something perfectly matched, like two mugs or two chairs. It means balance is being restored between you right now.

reading: Libra is tipping the scales your way. Today, receive. Someone will offer help, praise, a small favour, or a long-overdue thank you. The Wood Rat usually spots the gift and quietly hands it to someone else. Not today. Keep it.

Your stacked diamonds catch the moonlight tonight in a little ladder of sparkles, one for every person you helped level up this winter. Count them if you like. The [[Knight of Pentacles]] reversed says stop earning joy and just allow it. You have earned it ten times over already. The mountain can lean back against the sky for one evening and let the light come in.
nancy.mission: When Joel's message arrives today, reply with only thank you and one heart, no deflecting, and mean it.
nancy.omen: A scale, a seesaw or a balanced stack of stones. It means the universe is evening things out in your favour.

together.text: Fairness day. Joel sends three specific thank yous to Nancy. Nancy receives them without arguing. Then, together, pick one small thing to look forward to this spring and say it out loud at the same time over the phone.

game.intro: The scales tip toward the Mountain. Steady question, steady hands, wild guesses welcome.
game.question: Which slow thing is secretly the most satisfying to watch?
